_comment: Three workflows, because a tracker binds one workflow to a container and a container is usually a repository. The chain (build) is the flow that edits code, so it gets a project per repository. Explore and research are questions ABOUT repositories, so each owns one shared project and the card names the repository it is about. Mixing them into one graph produced a twenty-column board carrying three unrelated subjects.

workflows.why: one idea carried to shipped code; per repository because it edits code
one stage skill applied to something that already exists; shared across repositories
one product skill on one decision; shared across repositories

tracks.why: one idea carried to shipped code
one stage skill applied to something that already exists
one product skill on one decision
